Item.Value: SELECT CompanyID, CommunityID, Name FROM DP_CMN_Com AS a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CompanyID = {0} AND CommunityID IN (Select CommunityiD from DP_CMN_UserInfo WITH(NOLOCK) where CompanyID = {0} and UserID = {1} and Status =1) AND Status = 1

SELECT CC.Name , CU.Grade From DP_CMN_Com as CC WITH(NOLOCK) Inner Join DP_CMN_UserInfo as CU WITH(NOLOCK) ON CC.CompanyID = CU.CompanyID AND CC.CommunityID = CU.CommunityID WHERE CC.CompanyID = {0} AND CC.CommunityID = {1} AND CU.UserID = {2}

SELECT CM.* , CA.WriteAuth, CA.ReadAuth From DP_CMN_Menu as CM WITH(NOLOCK) Inner Join DP_CMN_MenuAuth as CA WITH(NOLOCK) ON CM.CompanyID = CA.CompanyID AND CM.CommunityID = CA.CommunityID AND CM.MenuID = CA.MenuID WHERE CM.CompanyID = {0} AND CM.CommunityID = {1} AND CM.Type In (1,2,3) ORDER BY CM.Sequence
SELECT * From DP_CMN_Menu WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CompanyID = {0} AND CommunityID = {1} AND MenuID = {2}
SELECT * From DP_CMN_BoaAttach WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CompanyID = {0} AND CommunityID = {1} AND MenuID = {2} AND BoardID = {3}

SELECT B.*, U.NameBase, U.NameKo, U.NameEn, U.NameJa , U.NameFr, U.NameZhcn, U.NameZhtw, U.ManyName ,U.DeptBase, U.DeptKo, U.DeptEn, U.DeptJa, U.DeptFr, U.DeptZhcn, U.DeptZhtw ,U.TitleBase, U.TitleKo, U.TitleEn, U.TitleJa, U.TitleFr, U.TitleZhcn, U.TitleZhtw ,(SELECT COUNT(BoardID) FROM DP_CMN_BoaView WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CompanyID = B.CompanyID AND CommunityID = B.CommunityID AND MenuID = B.MenuID AND BoardID = B.BoardID ) AS ReadCount ,(SELECT COUNT(RecommendID) FROM DP_CMN_BoaRecom WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CompanyID = B.CompanyID AND CommunityID = B.CommunityID AND MenuID = B.MenuID AND BoardID = B.BoardID) AS RecomCount ,U.AlarmCommunity FROM DP_CMN_Boa AS B WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN VW_UserInfo AS U WITH(NOLOCK) ON B.CompanyID = U.CompanyID AND B.WriteUserID = U.UserID AND U.BaseDept = 1 WHERE B.CompanyID = {0} AND B.CommunityID = {1} AND B.MenuID = {2} AND B.BoardID = {3}

SELECT B.*,U.NameBase, U.NameKo, U.NameEn, U.NameJa , U.NameFr, U.NameZhcn, U.NameZhtw, U.ManyName ,U.DeptBase, U.DeptKo, U.DeptEn, U.DeptJa, U.DeptFr, U.DeptZhcn, U.DeptZhtw ,U.TitleBase, U.TitleKo, U.TitleEn, U.TitleJa, U.TitleFr, U.TitleZhcn, U.TitleZhtw ,U.AlarmCommunity FROM DP_CMN_BoaShortReply AS B WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN VW_UserInfo AS U WITH(NOLOCK) ON B.CompanyID = U.CompanyID AND B.UserID = U.UserID AND U.BaseDept = 1 WHERE B.CompanyID = {0} AND B.CommunityID = {1} AND B.MenuID = {2} AND B.BoardID = {3} order by B.WriteDate

SELECT CU.* FROM DP_CMN_UserInfo as CU WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN DP_CMN_Com as CC WITH(NOLOCK) ON CU.CompanyID = CC.CompanyID AND CU.CommunityID = CC.CommunityID WHERE CU.CompanyID = {0} AND CU.UserID = {1} and CU.Status =1 AND CC.Status =1
